name: core.openwop.kanban-work-items
description: Core reusable Kanban WorkItem materialization. Converts an extension-owned reviewed plan into durable, dependency-aware Kanban work-item aggregates and board-card projections through ctx.kanban; it knows no canvas or feature-specific data model.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Materialize Kanban work items
nodes.description: Materializes a reviewed, namespaced plan into the selected board's reusable WorkItems and card projections. The host derives tenant scope and a deterministic delivery key from the run; a retry converges without duplicate cards. Compose after a review gate when the source process requires approval.
